task: binary classification: anti-inflammatory peptide (AIP) probability, softmax(logits)[:, 1]
architecture: Conv1d/MaxPool1d variational-autoencoder encoder (208-dim latent mu/logvar) + 2-layer classification head; decoder and triplet contrastive loss are training-only
input_encoding: fused one-hot (k=1) + multi-hot (k=2) + multi-hot (k=3) sliding window, 60 channels x seq_len, no ESM2

training_data.benchmarking: 3145 sequences (1258 pos / 1887 neg), CD-HIT deduplicated then split into train 2506 (997 pos / 1509 neg) and val 627 (250 / 377)
training_data.augmentation: random interception, sequence reversal, noise addition (training split only)
training_data.extra_source: IEDB T-cell assay export evaluated as an additional benchmark

loss: reconstruction (BCE-with-logits, pos_weight) + KL (free bits 0.02 nats/dim) + triplet contrastive + class-weighted cross-entropy
selection: best validation MCC with early stopping (patience 5)
